title: Replace a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence
summary: You can replace a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence by visiting a Service NSW Centre in person.
intro: If you need to replace a personal watercraft (PWC) driving licence, you can do so in person at a Service NSW Centre.
what_you_need: Your PWC driving licence details (if available)
The PDF form – 'Application for Replacement Products'
The PDF form – 'Application for a Personal Watercraft Driving Licence'

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Application for Replacement Product (Maritime) – PDF.
Download and complete the Application for a Personal Watercraft Driving Licence – PDF.
Make sure you have all the required supporting documentation.
Submit your application in person at a service centre.

more_info.text: The duration of a PWC driving licence can be one(1), 3, 5 or 10 years.
Licence fees vary depending on the duration of the licence, and whether they are concessional licences.
You must be under 16 years of age, or hold an eligible concession card at the time of payment, to receive a concession.

faqs.q: Where can I replace my PWC driving licence?
faqs.a: You must replace your licence in person at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to replace my PWC licence?
faqs.a: You need proof of identity, your PWC driving licence details (if available), two colour passport acceptable photos, the 'Application for Replacement Products' form, the 'Application for a Personal Watercraft Driving Licence' form, and payment.

faqs.q: What forms do I need to complete?
faqs.a: You need to download and complete the Application for Replacement Product (Maritime) and the Application for a Personal Watercraft Driving Licence.
